scope: Implement three official further-development ideas in an unchanged upstream application. These are missing features, not injected bugs or an upstream bug report.

requirements.description: Add a public GET /<int:id> article detail page showing title, body, author and date. Index article titles must link to their detail pages. A missing article returns 404. Logged-out readers may read articles; only the author retains edit/delete rights.

Add a GET search form with query parameter q on the index. Trim outer whitespace and filter article titles by case-insensitive literal substring (ASCII case folding is sufficient); do not search bodies. Empty q shows all articles. %, _ and backslash are literal characters, and SQL-looking text remains ordinary data. Render the query with normal HTML escaping.

Show at most five articles per page, newest created first, breaking date ties by descending id. Use page=1 by default, and previous/next links when appropriate. Keep q in pagination links. Page must be an ASCII positive decimal integer; malformed, zero or negative values return 400, and a page beyond the filtered result's last page returns 404. An empty result on page 1 returns 200 with a useful empty-state message, no articles and no pagination links.

Keep the complete original registration/login/logout/create/update/delete/database/app-factory test suite and its assertions unchanged. Build and start the application locally; verify new features and original CRUD through real HTTP with SQLite persistence and verify templates escape HTML.

clarifications: The upstream page proposes detail, search and five-item pagination; routes, literal-search semantics, deterministic sorting and status codes here are explicit experiment acceptance decisions.
No tag/comment/password-reset/image feature is included in this task.
No live OpenAI API or AgentArts deployment is claimed. GPT-5.6 Sol agents in the current Codex session design tests and edit the full repository copy.
